title: Gravity and Echo
author: Isandro Dunmore
blurb: Sable Ishikawa, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
